content.value: . A Parson's turbine consists of one row of fixed blades and one row of moving blades. The blade speed is 110 m/sec, mass of steam passing per second is 13.5 kg, steam velocity at exit from fixed blades is 144 m/sec, blade outlet angle is $2 0 ^ { \circ } .$ Assume the efficiency of conversion of heat energy into kinetic energy in the moving blade channels as 0.92. Calculate the (i) power developed in the stage, (ii) stage efficiency and (iii) maximum efficiency.
